description.value:
Remote lock apps allow you to control locks using your comm unit. Attempting a Thievery check to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Pick a Lock]{Pick} a smart lock without first successfully @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Hack]{Hacking} it automatically alerts the owner of the lock (and often, the local authorities) of a break-in progress. This virtual lock cannot be dismantled with the Thievery skill, only hacked using Computers.

Hacking requires four successful @Check[computers|dc:30] checks.
